tool.name: RemoveIGRF
tool.summary: Remove the IGRF from a total magnetic intensity grid: the IGRF total field for the survey date, calculated at every cell at sea level, is subtracted, giving the residual magnetic intensity (TMI - IGRF).
tool.usage:
Use it on a TMI grid, not on one that already has the IGRF (or a regional field) removed: a warning is given if the grid's median is far below the IGRF.

The IGRF grid is saved beside the output as <output>_IGRF.tif, but not added to the map. A Noddy grid carries its own uniform field, so it has no IGRF to remove.

The same calculation as the Remove IGRF button of the SGTool GUI and QGIS plugin.

param.name: in_raster
param.dialogReference: Grid to process (a single-band raster; no-data cells are left as no-data in the result).
param.pythonReference: Grid to process (a single-band raster; no-data cells are left as no-data in the result).

param.name: out_raster
param.dialogReference: Output raster (GeoTIFF), with the input's extent, cell size and coordinate system.
param.pythonReference: Output raster (GeoTIFF), with the input's extent, cell size and coordinate system.

param.name: year
param.dialogReference: Date the survey was flown, as a decimal year (e.g. 2023.5 for mid-2023).
param.pythonReference: Date the survey was flown, as a decimal year (e.g. 2023.5 for mid-2023).
